title: The Shrinking Landscape of Linguistic Diversity in the Age of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper includes a significant research component dedicated to evaluating how LLMs affect the expression of human morality. It specifically utilizes the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) framework to analyze five dimensions—Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, and Purity—and measures the preservation of these moral signals in LLM-rewritten text across several datasets.
